info.description: Article body: ordered WYSIWYG chunks + special widgets (carousel/stats/audio), with an optional internal sections nav.

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "industries" → #industries). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

variant.description: post = case-study rhythm (large section gaps + hairline). article = legal/content pages (tighter rhythm, h4 headings, 16px copy).
